# opnsense_acmeclient_account (Resource)

ACME accounts (**Services ▸ ACME Client ▸ Accounts**, plugin `os-acme-client`). The account is registered with the CA when the first certificate is issued.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_acmeclient_account" "le" {
  name  = "letsencrypt"
  email = "admin@example.com"
  ca    = "letsencrypt"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name to identify this account.

### Optional

- `ca` (String) The ACME CA that should be used for this account and all associated certificates. Note that some of them offer paid services and may require a subscription. Check the acme.sh documentation for a list of supported CAs. One of `buypass`, `buypass_test`, `google`, `google_test`, `letsencrypt`, `letsencrypt_test`, `sslcom`, `zerossl`, `custom`. Defaults to `letsencrypt`.
- `custom_ca` (String) The HTTPS URL of the custom ACME CA that should be used for this account and all associated certificates. If using your own CA, make sure the Root CA is added to OPNsense's trust store. For example: https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory or https://ca.internal/acme/directory. Defaults to ``.
- `description` (String) Description for this account. Defaults to ``.
- `eab_hmac` (String, Sensitive) An optional value provided by the CA when using ACME External Account Binding (EAB). Defaults to ``.
- `eab_kid` (String) An optional value provided by the CA when using ACME External Account Binding (EAB). Defaults to ``.
- `email` (String) Optional e-mail address for this account. Defaults to ``.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this account. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the ACME account.
